notes: Exact Marshall 1960A product page: four 12-inch Celestion G12T-75 drivers; cabinet power handling 300 W mono / 150 W stereo; unit impedance is 16/4 Ω mono or 8 Ω stereo. `power.value=300 W` retains the published mono rating as total cabinet handling; the stereo rating is preserved here in context, not collapsed or represented as a per-channel assumption. The cabinet is passive (external guitar-amplifier cabinet; the page describes speaker drivers, input(s), power handling, and output impedance, with no onboard amplifier), so active=false. Impedance remains N/A because this record has one scalar impedance field but the manufacturer specifies mode-dependent 16/4 Ω mono and 8 Ω stereo. Sensitivity, standard response limits, resonant frequency, and voice-coil diameter are not published. No response curve or directivity data is imported. Source: https://www.marshall.com/us/en/product/1960a-4x12-angled-cabinet?pid=1007269.

Exact Marshall Acton III product page: frequency range 45–20,000 Hz (no response tolerance or measurement conditions stated); built-in Class D amplifier ratings are one 30 W woofer amplifier plus two 15 W tweeter amplifiers. The built-in amplifiers support active=true. The page's 95 dB @ 1 m figure is maximum SPL, not sensitivity.
